initial_findings.description: A normal False from author_success previously left the candidate map populated; only an exception cleared it.
Strict filesystem row admission previously could stop on a mode/link/special-member refusal before retaining subsequent changed regular bytes.

verified_resolutions: Every non-pass clears derived product slots and candidate admission; the observed candidate filesystem tree and original evidence remain separately reported.
Source capture now records each changed regular file before mode/link admission; symlink and special members receive typed lstat/readlink metadata and are not opened or followed.
Individual capture refusals/errors are collected before a complete capture inventory is written; subsequent product admission requires no capture error or refusal.
Publisher independently requires a complete accepted capture, exact regenerated contract source_identity.files equal to all bound source pins, and equal expected profiles in contract and coverage.
The frozen read-only authoring process remains separate from the fixed publisher; the publication token is confined to the final publisher step.

The workflow still uses create-event/attempt-one/fixed trigger, exact pinned control/source checkouts, original 180-second owner/3-second cleanup/120-second command budgets, 59 generators, and 11 synthetic accounting controls.
limitations: Template placeholders, final source/profile/path counts, policy and control SHA are not yet frozen.
No AST parser, workflow, source generator, native image or product test was executed.
Capture errors remain explicit HOLD; the review does not claim recoverability of bytes that could not be read.
This review does not establish complete HIA-native delivery or qualify any earlier or future source snapshot.
